title: Recovered creation always says a goal was created, even for Action Button or Tiny posts
current: When a follow-up form's draft has expired but the creation is recovered as complete, the success toast always uses the 'goal' label.
evidence: The toast passes translate(language, 'moderator.create.goalLabel') regardless of the recovered post's kind; the normal path chooses between the goal and CTA labels.
investigate: Use the recovered post's kind for the label, or confirm this wording is intended.

criticality.why: Wording only; the right post is created and linked.
